summary: This 8-K/A amends a prior Form 8-K to provide pro forma financials for Generation Income Properties, Inc.'s sale of a Dollar Tree-occupied net-leased retail property in Morrow, Georgia. On April 17, 2026, the company via a wholly owned subsidiary sold the asset to Vanguard Asset Holdings, LLC, Series 102, for $1,458,000, yielding net proceeds of $639,152 after prorations. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a procedural update to disclose unaudited pro forma statements as if the sale occurred January 1, 2025. Watch for future portfolio repositioning or reinvestment of proceeds.
